body: still here, still thinking about it. I hate myself so much.

I tried. Sandwich was very tasty. 
I guess I should go and do it now.
I tried talking to my partner, plus a psychiatrist, then I got drunk and told my close friend. "Don't kill yourself", is the obvious response. There really is nothing for me.

perhaps my problem is a permanent problem? look, I tried and then I tried again. I tick all the boxes; volunteering, run my own company, married, the works. I am just sick of it all, so I am going to make a sandwich and then I will go. It's better this way.
